name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the quantum order-finding core of S
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the quantum order-finding core of Shor's algorithm in Qiskit to factor N=15 with base a=11: build controlled modular multiplication by permutation gates, run QPE, and extract the period with continued fractions to recover the factors. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
